title: My neighbour's dog
instructions: Emily komşusunun köpeğine nasıl baktığını anlatıyor. Ne zaman ve neden yaptığına dikkat et.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: My neighbour, Mr Green, is eighty years old and he has a big dog called Rocky.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Last year, Mr Green hurt his leg, so he couldn't walk Rocky.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: I offered to help, and now I walk Rocky every afternoon after school.

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Rocky is very friendly, but he's very strong. Sometimes he pulls me!

script.speaker: emily
script.text: Mr Green pays me ten pounds a week, but I would do it for free. I love that dog.

questions.prompt: Why couldn't Mr Green walk his dog?
questions.evidence: Mr Green hurt his leg, so he couldn't walk Rocky.

questions.feedback: Her öğleden sonra okuldan sonra gezdiriyor.
questions.evidence: I walk Rocky every afternoon after school.

questions.prompt: How much does Mr Green pay Emily?
questions.feedback: Haftada on pound ödüyor; Emily ücretsiz de yapardı.
questions.evidence: Mr Green pays me ten pounds a week
